question: What kind of teaching is said to be heard abiding in the ear, and by what mode of transmission does it reach the hearer?
premises: Something abiding in the ear is heard.
The address is made to the goddess.
That which is heard has come down by tradition in order.
inference: A teaching that has come down through successive tradition is heard abiding in the ear, O goddess.
uncertainties: Referent of the heard thing not named in this verse
plain_english: O goddess, that which has come down through tradition in order is heard abiding in the ear.
